central_repo_url.description: The URL of the central git repository used for synchronization.

hostname.description: The FQDN or hostname of the machine to configure.

enable_debug.description: Enable debug output for propellor (sets propellor.debug git config).

spin_branch.description: Refuse to spin unless this specific branch is checked out (sets propellor.spin-branch).

forbid_dirty_spin.description: Refuse to spin when there are uncommitted changes in the ~/.propellor repository.

build_system.description: Build system to use for propellor (cabal or stack).

privdata.description: List of privdata fields to manage. Each item is a map with 'name' and 'context'. See items schema.
